This permanently deletes "%1$s" and every file inside this instance folder, including saves, mods, configs, logs, resource packs, and shader packs.
Folder: %2$s

This permanently removes the shared/global version "%1$s" from .minecraft/versions.
Folder: %2$s
This cannot be undone. Shared libraries and assets are kept because other versions may still use them.

The shared vanilla files for "%1$s" are still required by these installed loader versions:
%2$s
Forge, Fabric, Quilt, and NeoForge versions can inherit files from the matching Vanilla version. Deleting the Vanilla folder would break those launches. Delete the dependent loader versions first, or keep this Vanilla version installed.
Remove inherited vanilla after loader install
Keep inherited vanilla after loader install

When enabled, new Fabric/Forge installs copy the needed vanilla client jar into the loader profile, flatten the inherited JSON, then delete the vanilla version folder only when no other installed loader version still needs it. This does not make libraries/assets per-instance; those remain shared launcher cache files.

Use Turnip (Adreno Only) driver with Zink
Forces the launcher to use the system Vulkan driver. Only affects Zink or mods that utilize this.
For Minecraft 26.x and newer only, this currently allows your device to use OpenGL.
Shows the small floating settings COG while Minecraft is running. This no longer controls the FPS counter; FPS has a separate option below.
Choose whether Android Back pauses Minecraft, opens the DroidBridge in-game launcher menu, or is disabled completely.
Keyboard shortcut for in-game launcher menu
Physical-keyboard shortcut that opens the DroidBridge in-game launcher menu before the key reaches Minecraft. Default: Ctrl + Esc. You can choose another key or key combination.

Press a physical-keyboard shortcut such as Ctrl + Esc, Alt + F8, or Ctrl + Shift + M. Modifier keys are captured together with the primary key. Home, Power, and App Switch are reserved by Android and cannot be used reliably.
This applies to Android navigation Back and gesture Back while Minecraft is running.
Current launcher orientation: %1$s. This controls DroidBridge menus and settings screens.
Choose how the DroidBridge launcher rotates. Auto Rotate allows portrait, reverse portrait, landscape, and reverse landscape.
Current game orientation: %1$s. This controls Minecraft while it is running. Auto Rotate switches between landscape and reverse landscape.

Choose how Minecraft rotates while it is running. Auto Rotate keeps the game in landscape and switches between normal and reverse landscape. Portrait (Centered Game View) keeps the phone/tablet portrait while placing Minecraft in a smaller centered landscape-aspect view.
Launcher auto-rotate allows all four rotations. In-game auto-rotate stays landscape or reverse landscape.
Current orientation: %1$s. Launcher screens and Minecraft will stay in this orientation until changed.
Choose launcher rotation. Auto-rotate allows all launcher rotations, but the in-game Minecraft surface only auto-rotates between landscape and reverse landscape.
Shows a small live latest-log overlay on the left side while Minecraft is running. Useful for debugging crashes without covering the full game screen.
Choose which Turnip/Adreno driver Vulkan Zink uses when the system Vulkan driver toggle is off. Default Mesa keeps the launcher bundled setup; installed driver plugins use their native driver folder.
